caption: The drawing depicts a brown leather saddle with intricate floral tooling covering the main body and fenders. The saddle features a high cantle and pommel, both outlined and accented in a pale off-white or cream color, with some blue shading present around the horn and cantle edge. The off-white areas are decorated with swirling gold-colored patterns. The stirrups are depicted in a light gray or silver tone. A single brown strap hangs vertically from the saddle, passing through a metal ring attached to the stirrup. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature, "R.L. Snittler," appears in small red letters near the lower right.
title: Child's Side Saddle
